label: Avalanche runout
compute: // The alpha-angle rule (Lied & Bakkehøi): the steepest angle at which an avalanche
// from 30-60° ground uphill still runs out to each spot. Short runs reach the
// high angles; only long-running avalanches reach the low ones.

presentation.footnote: Darker: reached by shorter avalanches. Terrain shape only: no snow, forest or release size.
